constraints: If SET FIELD TITLES has been called during the session, only the 'modified' names/numbers it defined are returned; otherwise all structure-defined field names are returned. Invisible fields are never returned, in either case.

overloadMerges.note: fieldTitles and fieldNums are filled in by the command (out), not in parameters.

params.name: aTable
params.description: Table whose field names/numbers are wanted

params.name: fieldTitles
params.description: Filled with the current (visible) field names

params.name: fieldNums
params.description: Filled with the corresponding field numbers, synchronized with fieldTitles

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Fills fieldTitles and fieldNums, in sync, with the names and numbers of aTable's visible fields.
